crash_rules.claim_partial_or_malformed: fail closed; never clean or replace uncertain state
crash_rules.receipt_post_link: same-inode exact receipt reconciliation and stage cleanup without boundary replay
crash_rules.receipt_stage_complete: predecessor exact validation/link/fsync/reopen reconciliation without boundary replay

execution_order: read-only validate exact authority, grant, map, owner roots and P0-v9/runner-v1 pins
derive fixed key from block/grant/input/map/owner-root identities without caller destination/root/clock choice
descriptor-relative create or validate fixed private reservation directory
atomically O_EXCL publish and reopen/hash one owner claim, or validate current immutable claim chain
recover PREPARED only when prior kernel process identity is inactive and zero effects are proven
fsync and reopen/hash ADMITTED before any predecessor destination preflight/mutation or provider/P0 boundary
delegate once to unchanged runner-v1 four-cell path
reconcile only an exact authenticated completed receipt stage/final state; otherwise publish UNKNOWN_NO_REPLAY
publish immutable COMPLETED event bound to exact receipt reference
input: exact authority registry/grant, frozen input, blind-map, runner owner root, two P0 adapter owner roots, bundle destination, and fixture boundary objects
loser_rule: a same-key loser either reconciles the exact completed receipt or fails closed before boundary; it never invokes predecessor execute after admission uncertainty
output: pinned execution_receipt_v6 reference or fail-closed reservation error; finalization delegates unchanged to authenticated v1 human/G3 path

process_rules.boot_change: old process identity is inactive; recovery still requires PREPARED and zero-effects proof
process_rules.pid_reuse: kernel start-token mismatch cannot inherit the claim; any permitted recovery is a new predecessor-linked claim after zero-effects proof
